name: Inferno launch-control clutch (Apex V8)
_note: A triple-plate carbon clutch with launch control for the Apex: holds 2,800 N·m (all the Inferno makes, so it counts as the triple-plate clutch the Inferno needs) and bites twice as fast; the auto-clutch launches at 5,200 rpm instead of 3,800, with the turbos already spooling.
